facts.title: Hearty Spaghetti with Lentils & Marinara
ingredients: ½ cup dry lentils (French green lentils or regular brown lentils), or 1 ½ cups cooked lentils (leftover or from a can, rinsed and drained)
1 large garlic clove, peeled but left whole
Optional garnishes: grated Parmesan or vegan Parmesan and/or chopped fresh basil
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
